evidence: IP ping from PC17 to DNS server 10.60.0.10 succeeds.
root_cause: PC17 is configured with the incorrect DNS server IP address 10.60.0.53 instead of the documented DNS server IP address 10.60.0.10.
verification: Run ipconfig /all on PC17 and confirm the DNS server address is 10.60.0.10.
Test domain name resolution using nslookup or by attempting to reach a known domain from PC17.
fix_steps: Verify the current DNS configuration on PC17 using ipconfig /all.
Update the IPv4 properties on PC17 to change the preferred DNS server address from 10.60.0.53 to 10.60.0.10.
Flush the local DNS resolver cache on PC17 using ipconfig /flushdns.
Test domain name resolution on PC17.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: PC configured DNS server (10.60.0.53) does not match active DNS server IP (10.60.0.10).
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Update PC IP configuration to set DNS Server address to 10.60.0.10.
